description: This file provides a no-operation implementation of OpenTelemetry tracing interfaces, including noop TracerProvider, Tracer, and Span, used for cases where tracing is disabled or not needed.

classes.name: noopTracerProvider
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of the TracerProvider interface.

classes.name: noopTracer
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of the Tracer interface.

classes.name: noopSpan
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of the Span interface.

methods.name: NewNoopTracerProvider
methods.description: Returns an implementation of TracerProvider that performs no operations.

methods.name: Tracer
methods.description: Returns a noop implementation of Tracer.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Carries forward a non-recording Span or creates a noop Span if none exists.

methods.name: IsRecording
methods.description: Always returns false, indicating the span is not recording.

methods.name: TracerProvider
methods.description: Returns the tracer provider associated with the span, which is a noop or auto-instrumented provider.

methods.name: tracerProvider
methods.description: Returns a noop or auto-instrumented TracerProvider based on the auto-enabled flag.
